caption: Figure 1: Spool maintains a sliding video window without replaying retained frames. (a) Shifting the window retains four of five frames. (b) Prefix-cache invalidation forces the retained context to be rebuilt. (c) Spool composes cached recurrent transformations and reclaims key–value slots by moving surviving tail entries into holes left by eviction.
